release.name: Memoria v0.4.9
release.body:
# Memoria v0.4.9

> One data-integrity fix (R0), two scroll-position bugs you reported, and four UI items.

## English

### 1. Data integrity fix (R0): saved files lost one trailing newline

If a document ended with a blank line (two or more trailing newlines), saving it
**permanently dropped one trailing newline and wrote that to disk**. Body text was
never lost — but this was the only path that could silently modify your files, so
it is treated as R0.

**Root cause (one line):** `_restoreDocTailNL` used `!body.endsWith("\n")` to decide
whether a trailing newline was missing. But the body is recomputed from the editor
DOM by joining lines, and joining `B.splitlines()` yields `B[:-1]` when `B` ends with
`\n`. Therefore `recomputed.endsWith("\n")` is true exactly when `B.endsWith("\n\n")`,
so a file ending with a blank line was misjudged as "already has its newline".

**Why it hid for two weeks:** the net length stayed the same. An inserted character
(+1) and the dropped newline (−1) cancelled out, so length-based checks saw
"nothing changed". The fix uses byte-level comparison instead.

**Evidence:** white-box 6 FAIL / 6 PASS before (files ending with `\n` and with no
newline both pass — proving only that one boundary was broken), 12/12 byte-equal
after; real-machine 14 failures before, 12/12 disk-byte-equal after; discriminating
power verified by reverting the fix (turns red) and restoring it (turns green).

### 2. Jump-to-target scrolling no longer drifts to the top

- **Any part of the target already visible ⇒ the view does not move at all** (not one pixel).
- Fully invisible ⇒ centred, and the direction follows the target (up when above, down when below).
- The follow-up re-alignment (350 ms / 1400 ms) now **only corrects drift** instead of
  re-pinning the target to the top, so MathJax reflow is still handled without snapping.

Real-machine time series: after a jump, `scrollTop` was sampled 11 times from 28 ms to
2004 ms and never changed. A drift-injection test (400 px inserted 70 ms after the jump)
corrected by exactly 400 px and returned the target to centre. An old-semantics control
run proved the probe can actually turn red.

### 3. Long-document preview no longer jumps back to the file start on edit

Editing the source pane used to reset the preview to the top **on long documents only**.
The real cause was not "long" — it was the **lazy-materialisation path**: to measure real
CSS metrics, the preview was forced to lay out while empty, which clamped `scrollTop` to 0,
and nothing restored it afterwards. Short documents render in one synchronous task, so the
browser never observed an empty state.

The fix keeps `scrollTop` across that measurement and restores the position by
**element / line anchor** (never by raw pixel value). Verified across 5 edit types ×
long/short documents (15/15) and a 2×2 control matrix showing the lazy path — not the
document length — is the causal variable.

### 4. UI

- **Sidebar expand/collapse stutter** reduced: dropped frames per cycle 5.0 → 4.0 (left)
  and 5.0 → 3.6 (right), max frame 66.7 → 58.4 ms. Animating `width` inherently reflows,
  so this is an improvement, not an elimination.
- **Document pane minimum width is now configurable** (Settings → Display, 320–560 px,
  default 360). Raising it makes the chat panel auto-hide earlier.
- **Context usage is now a ring** in the status bar instead of a long text string; hover
  shows the full numbers (`chars / limit (%) · compacted N times`).
- **Window restore**: a defensive transition suppression and a themed window background
  colour were added, plus a boot indicator (pulsing logo + indeterminate progress bar).
  **Honest note:** the black-screen and shrink-then-expand symptoms did *not* reproduce in
  our measurement harness, so these are defensive changes, not confirmed fixes.

### 5. Gates

`pytest` 1475 passed / 0 failed · `node --check` 59/59 · `i18n_selftest` PASS ·
`team_audit` FAIL=0 · 12 interaction scenarios 12/12.

## Cost (Agent compute)

**Magnitude:** roughly **CNY 300–800** of agent compute for this release cycle
(indicative estimate, not metered billing).

**Accounting basis:** combined across the whole session that produced v0.4.7 → v0.4.9,
because the work was interleaved and cannot be honestly split per version.

**Cost structure:** most of the budget went to real-machine verification (WebView2
instances, CDP probes, time-series measurement) and to a four-way design debate whose
proposals were each drafted independently — not to writing the code.

---

## 中文

### 1. 数据完整性修复（R0）：保存会丢一个尾换行

文档以空行结尾（尾部 ≥2 个换行）时，保存会**永久丢失一个尾换行并写进磁盘**。
正文内容从不丢失 —— 但这是唯一会「静默修改用户文件」的路径，因此按 R0 处理。

**根因（一行）**：`_restoreDocTailNL` 用 `!body.endsWith("\n")` 判断"是否缺尾换行"。
但 body 是从编辑器 DOM 逐行拼接重算的，而 `join(B.splitlines())` 在 `B` 以 `\n` 结尾时等于
`B[:-1]`。于是"重算结果以 `\n` 结尾"恰好等价于"`B` 以 `\n\n` 结尾"，导致以空行结尾的文件
被误判为"已有尾换行"。

**为什么藏了两周**：净长度不变。插入一个字符（+1）与丢掉一个尾换行（−1）恰好抵消，
于是基于长度的判据看到的是"什么都没变"。修法改用**逐字节比对**。

**证据**：改前白盒 6 红 / 6 绿（尾部无换行与单个换行两种都绿 —— 证明只有该边界坏），
改后 12/12 字节相等；真机改前 14 处失败，改后 4 篇文档 × 3 种编辑 + 重开 = 12/12 磁盘字节相等；
并做了**判别力自证**：把修复回退后立刻变红，恢复后变绿。

### 2. 点击跳转不再被拉到顶部

- **目标任意部分已可见 ⇒ 视图完全不移动**（一个像素都不动）。
- 完全不可见 ⇒ 居中，且方向跟随目标（在上方就向上，在下方就向下）。
- 后续的二次校准（350 ms / 1400 ms）改为**只补偏移**，不再把目标重新顶到顶部，
  因此 MathJax 排版变化仍能被修正，但不会被拽成顶对齐。

真机时间序列：跳转后从 28 ms 到 2004 ms 共采样 11 次，`scrollTop` **全程未变**。
注入漂移试验（跳转后 70 ms 插入 400 px 占位）只补了 400 px 并把目标还原到居中位。
另做了一次旧语义对照重放，证明探针**确实能判红**，绿灯不是"尺子坏了"。

### 3. 长文档预览编辑后不再跳回文件开头

在源码区编辑曾导致预览回到顶部，且**只在长文档出现**。真正的原因不是"长"，而是
**惰性物化路径**：为测量真实 CSS 度量，预览在「已清空、占位块尚未建立」的空态上被强制布局，
此时浏览器把 `scrollTop` 夹到 0，而重建之后没有任何恢复。短文档在同一个同步任务内完成渲染，
浏览器从未观察到空态，所以不会出问题。

修法是在该测量过程前后保住 `scrollTop`，并在渲染后按**元素 / 行号锚点**恢复位置
（绝不用原始像素值）。已用 5 种编辑类型 × 长/普通文档（15/15）验证，并用 2×2 对照矩阵
证明因果变量是**惰性路径**而非文档长度 —— 按"长"去修会修错地方。

### 4. 界面

- **左右侧栏展缩卡顿**改善：每周期掉帧 5.0 → 4.0（左）／5.0 → 3.6（右），
  单帧最长 66.7 → 58.4 ms。`width` 动画本身必然触发重排，所以这是改善而非消除。
- **文档区最小宽度可在设置里调**（设置 → 显示，320–560 px，默认 360）。
  调大后对话栏会更早自动隐藏。
- **上下文用量改为状态栏圆环**，不再用一长串文字占底栏；悬停显示完整数字
  （`字符 / 上限（%）· 已压缩 N 次`）。
- **窗口恢复**：加了过渡抑制的防御性处理、按主题设置的窗口底色，以及启动加载感
  （logo 轻脉冲 + 顶部不确定进度条）。**如实说明**：黑屏与"收缩→伸展"这两个现象
  在我们的测量环境里**没有复现**，所以这些是防御性改动，不是已确认的修复。

### 5. 门禁

`pytest` 1475 passed / 0 failed · `node --check` 59/59 · `i18n_selftest` PASS ·
`team_audit` FAIL=0 · 12 个交互剧本 12/12。

## 造价（Agent 算力）

**量级**：本轮发布约 **人民币 300–800 元**的 Agent 算力（估算量级，非计量账单）。

**统计口径**：**合并统计** v0.4.7 → v0.4.9 整个会话，因为工作是交织进行的，
无法诚实拆分到单个版本。

**成本结构**：大部分预算花在**真机验证**（WebView2 实例、CDP 探针、时间序列测量）
与一场**四方独立提案的设计辩论**上，而不是写代码本身。

## 下载

| 包 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `Memoria-v0.4.9-win64.zip` | 完整版（约 1.18 GB），内置模型，离线可用 |
| `Memoria-v0.4.9-win64-lite.zip` | 轻量版（约 35 MB），不含 `hf/` 模型目录；首次使用 embedding / rerank 需联网 |

解压后运行 `Memoria.exe`。
